name: Streaming On Observing Contracts Deontic Contracts Meet Smart Contracts 112E63A687
text: On Observing Contracts identifies a semantic gap through which smart-contract behavior can diverge from intended deontic behavior. This independently supports the mechanism in Kaal's claim that code and natural-language logic differ in ways that can frustrate human intent. The abstract proposition does not establish that this divergence occurs across all smart-contract settings.
